findings: WARN logging omitted follow details from both terminal and per-node ROS log; past pause durations cannot be recovered.
28 image recoveries and 9 discarded queued speech segments are observed; shared CPU pressure is a hypothesis, not established by these logs.
Whisper aborted with exit -6 after Ctrl+C; its daemon inference thread is not joined in current teardown, a possible cause requiring a separate fix/validation.
The application reported stop acknowledgement and capability release. These are software acknowledgements, not measured physical stopping.
The earlier passive measurement and this approximate process-window rate have different conditions/startup windows and are not a controlled performance comparison.
